    Exact meshes of a scalar mesh category and their descent to a prime field #

    The mesh data of a scalar mesh category C(Q, c) (CatAlg.MeshData): the right mesh maps are the arrows into each vertex, the left ones the coefficient-scaled mates, and the mesh sequences are exact (MeshExact). For k(Γ_A) this is Proposition 2.6(1)(2) (IndSkeleton.arMeshData).

    integral-deformations.tex: the prime-field model C⁽²⁾ inherits these properties "since it does so after the faithful field extension to k". Here (MeshExact.descend): exactness of the meshes of C(Q, c) over k, for a gauge c = η · (ι ∘ u) · μ μ, implies that of C(Q, u) over the subfield K, through the form functor and its retractions (FormFunctor).
